items.title: Obtain City of Las Vegas business license
items.authority: City of Las Vegas Business Licensing (with Clark County for unincorporated areas)
items.description: Businesses located in the City of Las Vegas need a city business license in addition to the Nevada state business license; businesses outside city limits use Clark County.

items.title: File fictitious firm name with the Clark County Clerk
items.description: Businesses operating under a name other than the owner's or entity's legal name file a fictitious firm name with the Clark County Clerk.
